text: Mariupol. Jets have been spotted above Azovstal alongside the helicopters. Their missiles are faster and hit harder.
Then we keep moving. What about our people on the ground?
Holding on. We take on the aircraft so they have one less threat overhead.
The Ukrainian dragon was destroyed yesterday. Today’s footage merely proves that yesterday’s dragon was the spare.
He just sneezed at your broadcast. The spare could never do that.
Switch it off. Mariupol is waiting for help.
If you hear from anyone defending Mariupol, thank them for me. I know every minute counts down there.
